sources.purpose: Experimental protein and macromolecular structures using PDBx/mmCIF as the canonical format.
sources.current_release_or_version: wwPDB release; current archive at https://www.rcsb.org/
sources.license_or_usage_terms: Open access / community usage terms established by wwPDB and RCSB
sources.update_strategy: weekly archive updates with periodic release snapshots
sources.provenance_requirements: download timestamp + file checksum + source accession + release pin
sources.notes: Primary experimental source for CHIMERA structural training.

sources.purpose: Predicted protein structures for sequence-structure coverage and augmentation.
sources.current_release_or_version: AlphaFold DB with current 2026 release coverage
sources.provenance_requirements: source=predicted, accession, release date, and pLDDT metadata
sources.notes: Separate from experimental structures; keep provenance distinct.

sources.purpose: Protein sequences, taxonomic identifiers, functional annotations, and cross-references.
sources.current_release_or_version: UniProt release 2026_03 at time of verification
sources.license_or_usage_terms: Open access / UniProt license and terms
sources.provenance_requirements: UniProt release + accession + taxonomy and annotation version
sources.notes: Core source for sequence and taxonomy linkage.

sources.purpose: Sequence accessions, gene records, genome assemblies, and annotation cross-links.
sources.current_release_or_version: current NCBI release; retrieval timestamp required
sources.license_or_usage_terms: Public-domain sequence records with database-specific terms
sources.checksum_support: yes, via FTP flatfiles and metadata
sources.rate_limit_information: API rate limits apply; use E-utilities responsibly
sources.update_strategy: continuous update with periodic public release snapshots
sources.provenance_requirements: accession, retrieval timestamp, and release metadata when available
sources.notes: Useful for taxonomic and sequence-provenance cross-references.

sources.purpose: European nucleotide archive for genomic and transcriptomic sequence records.
sources.provenance_requirements: ENA accession + retrieval date + assembly metadata
sources.notes: Useful for sequence-level discovery, especially when UniProt/NCBI mappings are incomplete.

sources.purpose: Protein family and domain annotations used for domain boundary detection and family linkage.
sources.current_release_or_version: current Pfam release represented on the public website
sources.license_or_usage_terms: Open access with family publication and data-use policies
sources.provenance_requirements: Pfam release + accession + domain coordinates + model version
sources.notes: Useful for domain and family-level information; keep domain annotations distinct from NRPS-specific evidence levels.

sources.purpose: Integrated protein family and domain annotation across Pfam, CATH, PROSITE, and others.
sources.provenance_requirements: InterPro release + accession + evidence method + annotation source
sources.notes: Good for integrated cross-database evidence and domain coverage tracking.

sources.purpose: Biosynthetic gene cluster metadata with domain and product annotations, including NRPS systems.
sources.checksum_support: yes; raw JSON tarball and file metadata available
sources.provenance_requirements: MIBiG accession + release + evidence type + gene-cluster JSON checksum
sources.notes: Critical for NRPS domain, module, and substrate annotation provenance.

sources.purpose: Biosynthetic gene cluster annotation, including NRPS/PKS region detection and domain calls.
sources.access_method: software + database output files / public releases
sources.file_format: JSON / GenBank / GFF / HTML / output tables
sources.license_or_usage_terms: Open access; software and data terms vary by release
sources.checksum_support: yes, through release artifacts when shipped
sources.provenance_requirements: tool version + cluster coordinates + annotation version + evidence level
sources.notes: Valuable as a computational annotation source; keep separate from experimentally confirmed annotations.

sources.purpose: Ligand and substrate chemical identifiers, properties, and cross-links for substrate association.
sources.license_or_usage_terms: Open access with NIH/NCBI policy terms
sources.rate_limit_information: API rate limits apply; use bulk FTP for large downloads
sources.provenance_requirements: chemical identifier, source database, and retrieval timestamp
sources.notes: Useful for substrate canonicalization and chemical metadata without conflating substrate identity with structure annotation.

sources.purpose: Ontology-backed chemical entity annotations for substrate and ligand normalization.
sources.provenance_requirements: ChEBI accession + ontology version + retrieval date
sources.notes: Useful for cross-referencing substrate chemistry and ontology-backed names.
